integrity: Analytical theorem with symbolic identities and independent high-precision numerical crosschecks; the latter are not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the positive-quadrant elliptic annulus of the specified genus-zero recurrence. The parabolic boundary and hyperbolic exterior are excluded. title: Exact unit-twist action–angle normal form and uniform rotation law for a genus-zero birational map
